instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside a bright ballet studio with a white wall and double wooden ballet barres, two young boys practice. On the left, the red-haired boy in a blue t-shirt and black shorts (R5) stands in the foreground, extending his left arm out to the side while looking forward. On the right, the brown-haired boy in a blue t-shirt and black shorts (R4) stands slightly behind him, holding the top wooden barre with both hands and looking forward. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting, highlighting the natural wood of the barres and the deep blue of their shirts.
